name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: A bold headline with a hatched drop shadow: fine diagonal lines fill the shadow and slide slowly through it.
useWhen: A headline needs a graphic, print-like shadow with a little life in it.
One word in a line should stand out with an engraved hatch shadow.
avoidWhen: You want a soft blurred shadow: use a plain text shadow.
You want a long solid extruded shadow: use long-shadow.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Lead-in
variables.description: Plain text before the shadowed word. Leave empty to show only the shadowed word.

variables.label: Shadowed text
variables.description: The word with the hatched shadow, set in italic.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Cycle
variables.description: Seconds the hatch takes to slide across the text (the source uses 15).
